messages:
marta: Vendor (Henrik) just pushed a partial RMA of 20 H200 units into our EU pool. Need quick decision on air vs sea + insurance docs. AWB pending. @samir can you confirm depot capacity for staging this week? cc @ops-bot

samir: FRA depot has room for 10 immediate intake slots, DUS can squeeze 3 with transfers, AMS is full. Air clears customs faster but adds ~€11–13k. Sea is ~10 days, much cheaper.

henrik_vendor: We can prioritize 12 units for air if Redwood covers the expedite fee. Sending proforma and insurer contact now. HS code: 8471. Customs need invoice + serial manifest.

marta: We need serial mapping before acceptance. If we route 12 by air, we can use them for EU hot-swap for Dedicated customers. Can finance approve partial expedite cost share? @liam

liam: Finance can approve up to €8k for expedite if ops covers the remainder. Need exact AWB numbers and insurance declared value before sign-off.

ops-bot: Depot capacity summary (live): FRA free slots 10, DUS free slots 3, AMS free slots 0. Air ETA 48–72h after AWB receipt, sea ETA ~10d. Transfer window between depots requires 4h lead time.

samir: Heads-up: 6 serials in the manifest flagged as firmware mismatch (batch B2). Vendor confirmed updated firmware available but will not pre-flash. We'll need to reimage at depot; estimate +4h/unit for those.

marta: Decision proposal: approve air for 12 units (priority), sea for remaining 8. Vendor to provide AWBs + insurance certificate + serial manifest in SFTP. Finance covers €8k, ops covers remaining ~€4k. Vendor must attach per-unit RMA label & manifest.

henrik_vendor: Acknowledged. Uploading AWBs now. Insurance policy ref: INS-4721EU. Manifest uploaded to SFTP: /redwood/provision/h200/1736543210_manifest.csv. RMA label added to each parcel.

samir: Received manifest, reconciling serials. I'm generating a short reimage runbook for the B2 firmware units. Runbook snippet:
```
- image: redwood/h200-2026-05
- flash tool: rfw-updater v2.1
- post-flash test: memory & nvme smoke (2x runs)
- tag for routing: eu-hot-swap
```
Estimate ops time slot: 6h block to handle 12 air units + reimages.

liam: Invoice expedite to GL: dedicated-provisioning, reference PO #DP-9812. CC @marta on invoice. Finance will release €8k on receipt of AWB + insurance cert.

marta: Confirming AWB (air 12): 1Z999AA10123456784. Sea shipment AWB will be provided when scheduled. Ops — please prep intake Wed 08:00 CET. Thanks all :thumbsup:

henrik_vendor: Tracking updated on AWB 1Z999AA10123456784, RMA number RMA-7821 on each label. Carrier ETA to FRA hub in ~36h. Will share sea booking later.

ops-bot: Noted. Intake scheduled: Wed 08:00 CET -> FRA dock. Creating intake ticket: INT-2026-4579.

marta: Closing loop — once units arrive, please confirm serial reconciliation and post-flash pass rate. If reimage fail rate >2%, we'll escalate to vendor for swap.

henrik_vendor: Understood. We'll standby for swap if needed. Thanks.
